mission.statement: Parse raw user-provided source code (single snippet/file), deterministically extract its semantic execution topology with jargon-free plain-language node descriptions, serve many users concurrently through a PostgreSQL-backed async job pipeline with prompt caching and entity-aware dedup, observe costs/token usage/agent iterations via Langfuse, and render results as 2D or 3D visualization — runnable end-to-end anywhere via Docker with only an env.example-derived .env.
mission.terminal_signal: On a clean machine: copy env.example to .env, fill keys, run 'docker compose up --build', submit multiple code snippets concurrently from different clients, poll jobs to completion, toggle 2D/3D, receive structured graphs with hoverable plain-language descriptions; identical/similar snippets return deduped cached topologies; traces visible in Langfuse Cloud.

goals.title: Scaffold & Contracts
goals.rationale: Establishes the Bun monorepo, shared Zod schemas (incl. async JobStatusSchema) as single source of truth, secrets contract, hooks/CI, and Docker-first testability so every later milestone runs identically anywhere.
goals.completion_signal: bun install && bun run lint && bun run typecheck pass; docker compose config validates; env.example exists and .env is gitignored

goals.title: Mastra Pipeline
goals.rationale: Implements the deterministic analyze -> generate -> validate -> heal workflow with provider-agnostic model routing and PostgreSQL persistence wired together with the pg-boss queue schema.
goals.completion_signal: Workflow accepts rawCode input and emits GraphTopologySchema-valid JSON; edge integrity validated; run snapshot + cache persisted to Postgres alongside pg-boss schema

goals.title: Visualization Frontend
goals.rationale: Delivers the user-facing value: paste code, choose 2D or 3D (the only mode switch), see a Dagre-laid-out flowchart or WebGL force graph with hoverable plain-language descriptions.
goals.completion_signal: Browser demo renders both modes from real workflow output; layout computed client-side by Dagre/ELK only

goals.title: Async Distribution, Caching & Observability
goals.rationale: Enables concurrent multi-user usage on commodity hardware: pg-boss job pipeline with worker pool, prompt cache, entity-aware embedding dedup, and Langfuse cost/token/iteration observability.
goals.completion_signal: N simultaneous POST /analyses all reach completed state without dropped jobs; duplicate snippet returns cached topology above SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD; Langfuse traces show token usage and costs

goals.title: Verification & Quality Gates
goals.rationale: Proves correctness (unit/integration), topology quality (Mastra evals), end-to-end behavior under concurrency, and containerized portability before mission completion.
goals.completion_signal: Vitest suite green; eval scores recorded; Playwright E2E green inside docker compose smoke test including parallel submissions

tasks.title: Bun monorepo scaffold
tasks.rationale: Foundation for all packages; must compile from first commit.
tasks.acceptance_test: bun install && bun run typecheck exits 0 with workspace resolution across frontend/, backend/, packages/types/
tasks.sdd_snippet: The architecture is an end-to-end TypeScript monorepo utilizing the Bun runtime. Frontend: Next.js (App Router) integrating @xyflow/react for 2D flowcharts and 3d-force-graph for WebGL 3D execution tracing. Backend: Bun server exposing type-safe endpoints.

tasks.title: Shared Zod schemas package
tasks.rationale: Single source of truth consumed by backend workflow schemas, DB layer, and frontend rendering — including the async job contract so the frontend builds against it before G5 exists.
tasks.acceptance_test: Unit test parses sample payloads against GraphTopologySchema (required plainDescription) and JobStatusSchema; typecheck passes
tasks.sdd_snippet: NodeSchema { id, label, type: enum[entry|process|io|branch|terminal], plainDescription: string, metadata? } EdgeSchema { id, source, target, animated default true } GraphTopologySchema { nodes[], edges[], detectedPatterns[] } GraphCacheSchema { codeHash, language, topologyPayload, embedding?, createdAt } JobStatusSchema { jobId, status: enum[queued|running|completed|failed], topology?, error? }. All validation uses Zod; no manual type duplication.

tasks.title: Husky pre-commit hooks + CI pipeline
tasks.rationale: Enforces strict static analysis and Zod schema validation gates mandated by protocol.
tasks.acceptance_test: Committing a file with a type error or failing lint is rejected by the hook; CI workflow lints/typechecks/tests on push
tasks.sdd_snippet: Pre-Commit Data Validation: The repository must enforce Husky pre-commit hooks that run strict static analysis and Zod schema validations before any code is staged.

tasks.title: env.example + Zod env loader
tasks.rationale: Secrets contract deliverable covering model routing, queue, embeddings, and Langfuse vars; agents never read .env — boot-time Zod validation of variable names only.
tasks.acceptance_test: Boot fails fast when required vars missing; passes with valid set; absent LANGFUSE_* keys disable tracing gracefully; .env confirmed gitignored
tasks.sdd_snippet: Vars: MODEL_PROVIDER, MODEL_ID, MODEL_BASE_URL?, OPENAI_API_KEY, GROQ_API_KEY, DATABASE_URL, WORKER_CONCURRENCY=4, EMBEDDING_MODEL, SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD=0.95, LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY?, LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY?, LANGFUSE_BASE_URL?, PORT, NODE_ENV. env.example holds names+placeholders only; .env gitignored; never read by agents.

tasks.title: Dockerfile + docker-compose (Caddy proxy + app replicas + PostgreSQL)
tasks.rationale: Docker-first testability with replica parity: anyone runs the full stack anywhere; local Caddy proxy mirrors production LB distribution.
tasks.acceptance_test: docker compose config validates; app service scales to >=2 healthy replicas behind Caddy; db healthcheck-gated with named volume
tasks.sdd_snippet: App service: multi-stage Dockerfile on Bun base; replica-ready (stateless). DB: PostgreSQL 16, named volume, healthcheck-gated. Proxy: Caddy reverse proxy fronting N app replicas. Acceptance: docker compose up --build yields end-to-end demo using only .env values.

tasks.title: analyzeCodeStep — AST/structural extraction
tasks.rationale: First workflow step; grounds LLM generation in deterministic structural facts and later feeds the entity-aware dedup representation.
tasks.acceptance_test: Step unit test extracts entry points, branches, IO ops, and named entities from sample JS/TS snippet into typed intermediate analysis
tasks.sdd_snippet: analyzeCodeStep: Parses rawCode and extracts AST/structural logic.

tasks.title: generateTopologyStep — provider-agnostic LLM topology generation
tasks.rationale: Core AI step; routes through Mastra model routing (OpenAI default, Groq swappable via env) and emits strictly schema-valid output including plainDescription per node.
tasks.acceptance_test: With mocked model, step output validates against GraphTopologySchema; no provider SDK imported directly
tasks.sdd_snippet: generateTopologyStep: Invokes the LLM to generate the JSON topology. Must output strictly to the GraphTopologySchema. No Provider Coupling: workflow steps never import provider SDKs directly; all model calls go through Mastra model-routing configured via MODEL_PROVIDER/MODEL_ID/MODEL_BASE_URL.

tasks.title: validateGraphStep + selfHealBranch
tasks.rationale: Guarantees referential integrity of the graph before it reaches clients; auto-repair loop prevents agent drift from breaking UX.
tasks.acceptance_test: Pure-TS validator catches dangling edges; self-heal branch retries with injected Zod errors max 2 times then fails deterministically
tasks.sdd_snippet: validateGraphStep: A pure TS validation step. Verifies that all edge.source and edge.target values exist in the nodes array. selfHealBranch: Triggers if validation fails. Injects the Zod error into the context and retries (maximum of 2 retries).

tasks.title: PostgreSQL wiring: @mastra/pg store + graph cache + pg-boss schema
tasks.rationale: No shadow databases rule: durable snapshots, memory, caches, AND the job queue are born together in the single Postgres instance — queue created with the database implementation per user mandate.
tasks.acceptance_test: Integration test against compose db: MastraStore persists/resumes snapshot; GraphCacheSchema round-trips keyed by codeHash; pg-boss send/fetch works on same DATABASE_URL
tasks.sdd_snippet: PostgreSQL is the global storage layer via @mastra/pg (snapshots, memory, traces, evals). pg-boss lives inside the existing PostgreSQL instance — its schema is created together with the database implementation (same migration/wiring step as the Mastra store). GraphCacheSchema keyed by SHA-256 codeHash. No Redis/libSQL/shadow DBs.

tasks.title: Code-input UI + typed polling API client
tasks.rationale: Entry point for non-coders; submits analysis jobs and polls JobStatusSchema until pending->ready transitions complete; consumes shared Zod types directly.
tasks.acceptance_test: Component test: paste triggers POST returning jobId; client polls status through queued->running->completed using shared JobStatusSchema parsing
tasks.sdd_snippet: POST /analyses returns { jobId }; GET /analyses/:jobId returns JobStatusSchema { jobId, status: queued|running|completed|failed, topology?, error? }. Frontend must consume the Zod schemas directly from the backend shared package; no manual type duplication.

tasks.title: 2D renderer (@xyflow/react + Dagre)
tasks.rationale: Primary accessible visualization; client-side layout math only, with plainDescription hover toast.
tasks.acceptance_test: Renders nodes/edges from fixture topology with animated edges, node-type colors, Dagre-computed positions, hover tooltip showing plainDescription
tasks.sdd_snippet: Next.js integrates @xyflow/react for 2D flowcharts. All layout math delegated to Dagre/ELK on the client side; AI agents forbidden from calculating X/Y coordinates. Every node carries plainDescription surfaced as hover tooltip/toast.

tasks.title: 3D renderer (3d-force-graph)
tasks.rationale: WebGL alternative view for complex topologies; same data contract, same plain-language tooltips.
tasks.acceptance_test: Renders fixture topology as force-directed 3D graph; hover surfaces plainDescription; no layout logic duplicated from 2D path beyond adapter
tasks.sdd_snippet: Next.js integrates 3d-force-graph for WebGL 3D execution tracing. User makes exactly one visualization choice: 2D or 3D. plainDescription shown on hover/toast in both renderers.

tasks.title: 2D/3D mode toggle
tasks.rationale: The single user-facing mode switch; wires both renderers behind one control without exposing other settings.
tasks.acceptance_test: Toggle switches renderers preserving loaded topology; exactly two options available; state survives re-render
tasks.sdd_snippet: The end user makes exactly one visualization choice: 2D or 3D. No other mode toggles are exposed.

tasks.title: Async API endpoints + worker pool
tasks.rationale: The concurrency core: fire-and-poll distribution that lets many users share one small machine without connection exhaustion.
tasks.acceptance_test: N=8 simultaneous POST /analyses all enqueue; worker pool processes up to WORKER_CONCURRENCY in parallel; all jobs reach completed with valid topology; GET returns correct statuses throughout
tasks.sdd_snippet: POST /analyses enqueues via pg-boss, returns { jobId }. GET /analyses/:jobId returns JobStatusSchema. In-process worker pool pulls jobs with WORKER_CONCURRENCY (default 4); durable snapshots make jobs resumable across restarts and deploys. App holds zero session state.

tasks.title: Prompt cache layer
tasks.rationale: Identical prompts skip the LLM entirely, cutting cost and latency for repeated analyses.
tasks.acceptance_test: Same rendered prompt+model twice: second call hits cache table keyed by (promptHash, modelId) without invoking mocked LLM
tasks.sdd_snippet: Postgres table keyed by (promptHash, modelId) -> cached completion payload. Hash = SHA-256 of fully rendered prompt string + model id. Cache hits skip the LLM entirely for identical prompts.

tasks.title: Entity-aware embedding dedup service
tasks.rationale: Similar snippets return cached validated topology instantly while keeping real entity names — ludic, meaningful labels preserved for non-coders.
tasks.acceptance_test: Two structurally-equivalent snippets differing only in ordering/formatting match above SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD and return the first topology; embedding calls themselves hit the embedding cache table
tasks.sdd_snippet: Entity-aware normalized representation: AST-derived skeleton preserving entity names (functions, variables, parameters) alongside control-flow shape, embedded via provider-routed EMBEDDING_MODEL and stored on the topology cache entry. Cosine similarity above SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD returns existing validated topology. Embedding calls subject to embedding-cache table (inputHash, model -> vector).

tasks.title: Langfuse observability wiring
tasks.rationale: Cost, token usage, and agent iteration visibility with zero custom instrumentation via Mastra's official exporter.
tasks.acceptance_test: With keys present: workflow run produces trace in Langfuse containing spans for each step with token usage/cost; with keys absent: app boots and runs normally with tracing disabled
tasks.sdd_snippet: Mastra's native observability exports to Langfuse Cloud free tier via official @mastra/langfuse LangfuseExporter. Captured per trace: span timeline of workflow steps and agent iterations, token usage, cost data, timing. Absent keys => tracing disabled; app still runs.

tasks.title: Vitest unit/integration suite
tasks.rationale: Regression safety net across schemas, workflow steps, queue endpoints, and cache/dedup services.
tasks.acceptance_test: bun test (vitest) exits 0 covering schema parsing, validator rejection cases, self-heal retry limit
tasks.sdd_snippet: @sdet: Write unit, integration, and E2E tests validating the criteria specified in the SDD. Report pass/fail logs directly back into the task card before review sign-off.

tasks.title: Mastra evals scoring topology quality
tasks.rationale: Measures whether generated graphs are logical and sense-making, not just schema-valid; scores persist to Postgres and Langfuse traces only (no UI surface).
tasks.acceptance_test: Eval run produces scores above defined threshold for reference snippets; results persisted to Postgres observability storage and visible as Langfuse trace metadata
tasks.sdd_snippet: Utilize Mastra's built-in evaluation tools (evals) to score agent outputs and measure quality alongside standard unit tests. Eval scores persist to Postgres observability storage and appear in Langfuse traces only - no UI surface.

tasks.title: E2E happy path + Docker compose smoke test incl. parallel load
tasks.rationale: Terminal acceptance: mission-complete proof on a clean machine, inside containers, under concurrent multi-user load.
tasks.acceptance_test: Playwright E2E inside docker compose: two clients submit simultaneously -> both poll to completed -> select 2D -> graphs render -> toggle 3D -> render; duplicate second submission resolves via dedup/cache path
tasks.sdd_snippet: Acceptance: docker compose up --build on a clean machine yields the end-to-end demo using only .env values, surviving multiple simultaneous submissions.
